families_source: The 7 adjustment families of the adjustment-layer grammar (TRIGGER -> AFFECTED -> DIRECTION -> MAGNITUDE -> LOG), per docs/engine/research/2026-09-27/total-signal-wiring-spec.md (Signal taxonomy v1).
rule: family must be one of `families`; type_id must be a registered type whose family matches. New families/types enter only by a registry version bump.
spec: SPEC-C §1.1 / §1.6 (FFW-26 addendum, DRAFT — Freeze-1-C pending ratification)

types.description: A starting offensive lineman (LT or C) is officially inactive for the game.
A starting safety or CB1/CB2 is officially inactive for the game.
A starting edge rusher is officially inactive for the game.
An elevated skill player's team rush share meets or exceeds a declared threshold.
Neutral-situation seconds-per-play meets or exceeds a declared threshold under declared weather conditions.
The trailing team's rush share is at or below a declared threshold (pass-heavy script).
A short-rest / long-travel team's penalty yards meet or exceed a declared threshold.
The archived spread moves toward the home team by at least a declared threshold between two declared captures.
